name: vietnam-basemap-preview
description: Standalone developer preview for the Vietnam Basemap Platform

scripts.check:platform: cargo fmt --manifest-path Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo check --manifest-path Cargo.toml --workspace && cargo test --manifest-path Cargo.toml --workspace
scripts.check:tauri: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:platform && npm run check:tauri
